verdict.rationale: Codex lets you inspect the summary and diff of cloud task results before opening a pull request. It also offers a dedicated review against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch, reporting prioritized findings without modifying the working tree so you can address risks before you commit or open a PR. It can run commands and local development tools as part of the work. missing for 10: explicit documentation of running test/lint/CI checks as part of the review, independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.

Run a dedicated review against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch. Codex reports prioritized findings without modifying your working tree, so you can address risks before you commit or open a pull request.
Let Codex inspect files, make edits, and run the tools already installed on your machine.
Use Codex interactively or call codex exec from repeatable workflows and pipelines.
